This is the `extdata/germline_sequences/AIRR/human/202309/` folder
in the **igblastr** package.

This folder contains germline sequences (in FASTA format) extracted from
the following AIRR-community/OGRDB datasets for Human:
- `IGH_VDJ` version 7
- `IGKappa_VJ` version 2
- `IGLambda_VJ` version 1

These were the most current versions at the date indicated by the name
of this folder (202309 i.e. Sept 2023).

AIRR-community/OGRDB provides two flavors of each dataset, one called
the "Reference Set" and the other one called the "Source Set". The `ref/`
subfolder contains the former and `src/` the latter.

See `README.md` file in each subfolder for more information.
